about: Totals observed outside the result rows (e.g. a review's run whose rows were not kept). evacplan.harness.load_recorded_observations reads this file; the leaderboard uses only observations of b2_vrptw, as B2's best observed total in the bar for beating B2, and only in the table of the same set, budget and exact host string (rows and observations of different hosts are never compared; program/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-01). Add an entry only with a source that documents the number. Keys: set, budget_s, method, host, delivered_checked, source (required); unresolved, commit, recorded, note (optional).
